At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with government services teams:

Government services
  Delegated: Receive applications, organise supporting records and communicate progress through the authorised channel.
  Stays with you: Statutory decisions, appeals and sensitive disclosures stay with authorised officials.
  Exception: An application is missing a supporting record.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.

See the government services workflow: https://uieglobal.com/solutions/government-services/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-gov
